All 6 scope areas are specified with concrete deliverables, file paths, and interface contracts. Existing surface is preserved — only memory_controller.py and __init__.py are modified, with all 8 untouchable brain files protected. Runtime boundary integrity is strong — 14 files in absolute prohibition, explicit import rules, separate brain_state.db. Test coverage covers all 8 areas with 80+ tests minimum. NSEC Article 37 is fully respected with explicit implementation freeze and human approval gate.
